evidence: ImageNet is a dataset service, not an installable software repository.

Static inspection of archived openai/gym master shows requirements.txt, test_requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, setup.py and py.Dockerfile plus README documentation. Exact versions/dependency normalization are Stage 3 and nothing was installed or executed.
The Zenodo dataset includes mesh formats compatible with CARP but no software environment/dependency manifest was verified as part of the dataset record.
